description.zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询。
description.en: The application ID, which can be created and queried in the console.

description.zh: 开启和结束旁路的回调地址。回调内容请参见下文中的CallBack回调示例。
description.en: The callback URL used to notify the start and end of the relay. For details about the callback content, see the CallBack callback example below.

description.zh: 模糊匹配频道ID的前缀列表。
description.en: The list of channel ID prefixes that are fuzzy matched.
The list of channel IDs that are exactly matched.

description.zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值。
description.en: The encoding option. For more information, see the MediaEncode enumeration values below.

description.zh:
自动旁路的播流域名。自动旁路任务对应播流地址为rtmp://${domain}/${app}/${stream}。

- domain: 您的直播播流域名。
- app: live。
- stream: urlencode(${AppId}_${ChannelId}_${UserId}_${SourceType})，其中SourceType为输入源类型。
description.en:
The streaming domain name for automatic relay. The streaming URL of an automatic relay task is in the format rtmp://${domain}/${app}/${stream}.

- domain: your live streaming domain name.
- app: live.
- stream: urlencode(${AppId}_${ChannelId}_${UserId}_${SourceType}), where SourceType indicates the type of the input source.
The name of the relay rule.

title.zh: 创建自动旁路单路转推规则
title.en: Create an automatic single-stream relay rule

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
本接口用于创建旁路规则。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
This operation is used to create a relay rule.
# QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit of this operation is 1,000 calls per minute. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Call the operation properly. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
